EO-003.note: Native PNG Save/Save As validate paths and adopt only complete successful results. Full user-facing formats and filesystem/platform qualification remain. Native Save As now offers only PNG/JPEG/WebP with matching extensions, explicit required JPEG/WebP quality (0..100), and required opaque JPEG matte (#RRGGBB). PNG/WebP retain alpha; JPEG composites onto the chosen matte on the worker. Core validates options without clamping or invented persisted defaults. Actual codecs, bytes/hash, alpha/matte, quality changes, immutable source/annotations, pair reopen and companion-only repair are tested. Successful Save remembers chosen options only in that editor window; failed/partial Save As keeps the old durable path, and repair uses its acknowledged format without another encoding. Existing overwrite confirmation remains, all blocking save work now starts through OwnedWork, and an encoding-boundary cancellation regression prevents starting an encoder. Empty-document alpha messaging explicitly discloses that companions exist only with annotations, per ES-014. Full codec/profile/resource/native-target/fault/a11y/human qualification and reconciliation of the format-selection draft status remain Required.
